segments.name: Restaurants
segments.description: Operates fast-casual restaurants serving Chicago street food across multiple channels including dine-in, drive-thru, delivery, and catering.
segments.evidence: Portillo's serves iconic Chicago street food in high-energy, multichannel restaurants designed to ignite the senses and create memorable dining experiences.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay the company for food and beverage products sold at its restaurants, through dine-in, drive-thru, delivery, and catering channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues from retail restaurants are presented net of discounts and recognized when food and beverage products are sold to the end customer.
